name: What happens during mobile home wall and ceiling repair?

mainEntity.name: What happens during mobile home wall and ceiling repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first step is to identify the cause of the damage, especially if there was a roof or plumbing leak. After that, the damaged section is protected, cut out if needed, repaired with matching materials, then taped, textured, and finished to blend with the surrounding surface.
acceptedAnswer.description: A good repair starts with finding the cause, then patching or replacing the damaged section, finishing it, and matching the texture.
